title: The Quiet Will
author: Z. M. Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Thornbury, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
